content.guideline_title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
content.scope: This document includes a review of previously published guidelines to avoid repeating existing recommendations.
content.evidence_review: Literature from research involving human subjects, indexed in MEDLINE, EMBASE, Cochrane Library, the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality, among others.
content.writing_committee: Consisted of cardiologists, cardiac electrophysiologists, surgeons, pharmacists, and patient representatives/lay stakeholders.
content.document_review: Peer review committee with representatives from ACC, AHA, and collaborating organizations.
